evidence.reason: The finding objected to `allow_force_pushes` being enabled on `main` for the H4 drill. The current tip text already records that the setting was enabled only on the mistaken assumption drill b needed it, that drill b force-pushes `merge-queue` and not `main`, and that it was rolled back in _Left in place_. The history commit `9fbedc869c2919ea3d8b5a396ec824ddfca7ecb7` ("fix(review): correct H4 drill refs API, YAML note and force-push rollback") is the content fix that added the rollback note, so the concern is addressed at the tip.
